Good afternoon, and thank you for joining our third quarter results call. I will start with the commercial line. Prices were reviewed in all four regions during the quarter, and a new benchmark was introduced for the fresh categories. As a result, a gain of two hundred and forty million was reported in commercial efficiency, and this figure has been audited by our external firm. I want to be clear about one point, because it was raised by two of you last quarter. No store was closed to reach this number. The gain was delivered by pricing work alone. The full disclosure is available in the document that was published this morning on our investor page.

Hi everyone, quick briefing on the new sign-off rule, because it starts on Monday. Until now, a price change under five percent was approved inside the commercial team. From Monday, every change above the threshold must be signed off by two people, and the reason must be recorded in the system. I know this sounds heavy. It is not about trust. It is about disclosure: when the regulator asks why a price moved, the answer has to be found in one place, not in six email threads. Any variance above ten percent will also be reviewed by the compliance team. If you have questions, they should be sent to me before Friday. Thanks.

First, a new benchmark is set for the category. Then the prices are reviewed in all four regions. After that, every change above the threshold is signed off by two people. Next, the results are audited by an external firm. Finally, the gain is reported in the official release.
